messages:
Anna K: Quick sync — planning a gradual launch for inference model v4.2.1 tomorrow morning. Need help deciding percent schedule, region scope, and rollback thresholds. Who's got bandwidth to own the flag ops?
Raj P: I can own the flag toggle. thinking 0 -> 1 -> 5 -> 20 -> 50 over ~6 hours, with a pause at each step for 30min metric check.
Emily S: +1 for staged increments. Can we limit the initial 1% to users in US-East + internal beta only? want to keep EU off until we validate regs + latency.
Lina (oncall): Sounds good. Can we gate on both error rate and tail latency? If 5xxs + p99 latency both up > 3% relative to baseline for 15m, auto rollback.
Mike T: Suggest adding a daily window rule so we don't ramp during peak batch jobs — target start 06:00 UTC. Also add a circuit-breaker flag for immediate disable.
Anna K: Good call. Raj — can you create the feature flag and the rollout plan in the ops repo? format we use: feature key, allowed regions, audience-attrs, schedule, rollback-rules.
Raj P: Will do. Drafting flag now. snippet of what I'll create:
```json
{
  "key":"inference.model.v4_2_1.rollout",
  "audience":"internal,beta",
  "regions":["us-east-1"],
  "schedule":[0,1,5,20,50],
  "step_duration_mins":30,
  "start_time":"2026-03-18T06:00:00Z",
  "rollback_criteria":{ "error_pct_increase":3, "p99_latency_increase":3, "window_mins":15 }
}
```
Emily S: can we also add a header-based canary so we can route specific customer IDs? e.g., X-Canary-Group: beta. That helps reproduce failures without broad impact.
Raj P: Yep — will add audience attribute and a sticky cookie for session affinity.
DeployBot: feature-flag created inference.model.v4_2_1.rollout by raj_p — id ff_2287 :rocket:
Lina (oncall): I've added a dashboard card for the rollout: /dashboards/ops/model-rollouts/ff_2287. It tracks p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, and sample outputs diff.
Mike T: QA note — please run the regression eval set after the 5% step. If any prompt group drops below 95% pass, hold ramp.
Anna K: Summary: Raj creates flag (ff_2287), audience = internal+beta + region us-east, schedule 0-1-5-20-50 w/30m pauses, start 06:00 UTC, rollout dashboard + auto-rollback on >3% error or p99 rise. Raj will ping when flag is live and when each step completes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
